correctness.rationale: On every-side-occupied configurations a deterministic nonoverlapping triangle dissection yields exactly the corner-product sum; the complement probability decays exponentially. The joint no-sample probabilities on shrinking disjoint corner intervals converge to independent exponential survival laws. Uniform exponential tails give all moment limits. Exact survival integration yields finite-N corner-product expectation and the exponentially controlled all-order formula. Independent product transforms and Laplace saddle plus finite subexponential convolution establish the sharp tail. Permutation-average Jensen and strict sine concavity give the two distinct equality classifications. A standard-library program tested exact integrals, convex-hull geometry, and product moment estimates; finite tests are not infinite proofs.
